title: System Memory Entity
description: Defines bare-metal/VM memory requirements: size, swap, swappiness, resource limits. Tools translate to OS-specific mechanisms.

swap_file.description: Swap file path (e.g., /swapfile). If omitted, tool decides.

max_open_files.description: Maximum open file descriptors per process.

max_processes.description: Maximum number of processes per user.

hugepages.description: Huge pages configuration for memory-intensive workloads.

count.description: Number of huge pages to allocate.

shared_memory.description: Shared memory size (e.g., "256m"). Maps to /dev/shm or equivalent.
